dataset_name: SolveX Palakkad Division prototype train dataset
notes: Times are scheduled timetable times, not live running times.
Station records are limited to Palakkad Division-relevant infrastructure.
For daily trains, timetable day offsets are used to map station events onto the requested calendar dates.
This is a verified seed dataset, not a claim of exhaustive all-service coverage; special/seasonal/unreserved services may require separate timetable verification.
